scope: UNIDAD core, model runtimes, SOVENGI, GNOSIS, CLI, HTTP, memory, tools and training

classification.conversation: executes or supplies evidence in the conversation path
classification.explicit_service: available through an explicit operation or host configuration
classification.manual_learning: host-selected corpus and finite execution; not triggered by chat
classification.development_adapter: lower-level access to the same core for experiments

baseline.connection: SOVENGI, GNOSIS and HTTP dispatch model operations through the same Brain and host-selected runtime.
baseline.gap: One conversational Transformer is loaded; character RNN and metric MLP are separate explicit operations.

baseline.connection: ConversationEngine owns generation and tokenizer-based prompt measurement; the selected reference is reference-wiki1.
baseline.gap: Other trained artifacts can be selected by host configuration but do not participate together in a reply.
baseline.inventoryNote: This local availability snapshot differs from the larger Git catalog; manifest aliases are not additional distinct weights.

baseline.connection: ModelRuntime loads its verified packaged weights and exposes language.generate, using the configured NumPy or NERVA backend.
baseline.gap: It does not evaluate generated conversational candidates at baseline.
baseline.usefulConnection: Bounded next-character likelihood of original candidates, with unknown-character coverage and explicit absence of factual validation.

baseline.connection: attention.forecast validates supplied observations against the loaded model's source, metric, privacy and cadence.
baseline.gap: Its predictions are not conversational evidence unless a host deliberately provides them to the conversation.
baseline.usefulConnection: An explicit forecast-to-conversation bridge for valid supplied observations; no fabricated observations or general quality score.

baseline.connection: SOVENGI restores actual dialogue roles, selects original user sources and fits complete sources to the active engine's token budget.
baseline.storage: SQLite WAL with FTS5 when available
baseline.limits: Lexical ranking is not semantic understanding; assistant text remains dialogue and is not promoted to user facts.

baseline.connection: SOVENGI recalls bounded original saved task fields through workspace.recall_tasks and includes fitting evidence in conversation replies.
baseline.limits: Saving memory neither updates parameters nor makes an unverified attempt factual.

baseline.connection: It executes the configured character RNN and optional token selection from real Transformer logits through nerva or nerva-fast.
baseline.limits: Transformer neural computation and training remain PyTorch; activating a slower backend is not an optimization by itself.

baseline.connection: plan, train, status and export delegate to the shared trainer and jobs with artifact identities, corpus hashes and finite budgets.
baseline.gap: SOVENGI exposes plan/train while learning status/export require the lower-level GNOSIS entry point at baseline.
baseline.limits: The supplied default configuration has no learning corpus; model profiles are not trained weights.

baseline.connection: The supervisor already launches bounded jobs, observes real process state, records post-stage evaluation and coordinates the configured collector.
baseline.limits: These are explicit application scripts, not an autonomous learning process started by ordinary chat. Process activity was not inferred from file presence.

baseline.connection: ModelActionProposer shares the selected conversation engine; the controller validates generated proposals and retains actual task evidence.
baseline.limits: Host-configured file roots and tools remain authoritative; task observations have their own journal instead of importing another chat's memory.

baseline.connection: SOVENGI CLI and its authenticated HTTP server use the same SovengiSession; explicit workflows dispatch the same bounded operations.
baseline.limits: One HTTP server hosts a fixed body session; incoming text cannot choose models, roots or new tools.
baseline.developmentAdapters: brain, gnosis and conversation CLIs retain lower-level access to the same core; SOVENGI adds product memory and context policy.

baseline.connection: Generation uses the existing KV cache when configured. The trainer already connects mmap, supervised projection, microbatches, optional CPU BF16 and optional adaptive sampling.
baseline.limits: Incompatible loader/sampling settings are rejected; enabling every optimization together is not valid. Technical throughput does not establish language quality.

duplicationAssessment.packagedRnnAndMlp: Portable verified copies of public own-weight artifacts, not additional experts.
duplicationAssessment.multipleClis: Adapters for different levels of the same core, not independent neural implementations.
duplicationAssessment.historicalCheckpoints: Experimental evidence and alternative host-selectable weights; file presence alone does not justify activation.

implementedConnections.connection: Own trained preference selector to candidate coordination
implementedConnections.behavior: conversation_selector loads verified own pairwise-preference weights once and shares the same selector object through the common ensemble across bodies. Inference receives original generated candidates and diagnostics, without training utilities, and returns one original candidate unchanged.
implementedConnections.trainingPolicy: Separate TRAIN and validation cohort IDs; caller must additionally preserve complete family partitions. The trainer has no TEST argument. Selection uses minimum validation pairwise loss.
implementedConnections.limits: This optional linear selector uses lexical and diagnostic features; it does not verify facts, establish conversation quality or activate a new artifact without host configuration. A single-model configuration rejects a coordination selector.

implementedConnections.connection: Own Transformer catalog to shared conversation runtime
implementedConnections.behavior: GNOSIS accepts a pinned host-selected catalog and passes ModelSpec descriptors through Brain and ModelRuntime to ConversationEnsemble. Models coordinate through original generated text, including different tokenizers.
implementedConnections.limits: Time limits are cooperative between operations. Configured roles do not prove trained specialization. The selected reply remains one original generated candidate.

implementedConnections.behavior: ModelRuntime supplies the verified own RNN scorer as the ensemble auxiliary callback; candidate text is scored without replacement or completion. The protocol also exposes language.score and SOVENGI exposes score.
implementedConnections.limits: Character likelihood and vocabulary coverage do not verify facts, grammar or intent; a one-character candidate has no next-character target and abstains.

implementedConnections.connection: Metric MLP predictions to conversation evidence
implementedConnections.behavior: conversation.forecast takes explicit observations, validates their trained source and metric, computes actual forecasts and attaches bounded prediction evidence to the shared conversation path. SOVENGI applies its usual context and saved-memory policy to that path. Preparation errors preserve completed explicit workflow effect receipts.
implementedConnections.limits: Observations are neither fetched nor invented. Predictions remain experimental predictions, not observed or accepted facts. The MLP does not evaluate ordinary dialogue.

implementedConnections.behavior: GNOSIS accepts optional language_model and attention_model artifact paths selected by the host instead of restricting product composition to the packaged demonstrations.
implementedConnections.limits: Conversation input cannot replace models or choose artifact paths. Learning runs cannot overwrite selected auxiliary artifacts. Forecast source and metric still come from the selected model's verified artifact.

implementedConnections.behavior: ModelActionProposer measures prompts through engine.prompt_usage rather than accessing a single Transformer's private model/tokenizer fields, preserving compatibility with the ensemble facade.
implementedConnections.limits: Task tools, roots and evidence journals retain their existing host policy. This repair does not establish reliable learned planning.

implementedConnections.connection: Learning status and export to the SOVENGI entry point
implementedConnections.behavior: SOVENGI now exposes learning-status and export alongside the existing GNOSIS plan/train commands; these call the same explicit stage lifecycle.
implementedConnections.limits: No private dialogue is automatically converted into a corpus, no training starts from ordinary chat, and exported candidates are not automatically accepted.

implementedConnections.connection: NERVA conversation configuration and reported capability
implementedConnections.behavior: The existing optional real-logit conversation selector remains host-configurable; GNOSIS no longer incorrectly describes NERVA as limited to the character RNN.
implementedConnections.limits: The supplied default remains Torch with its KV cache; the transformer forward pass and training continue in PyTorch.

implementedAuxiliaryScorer.conversationUse: Configured ensembles score original generated candidates as a diagnostic and tie breaker when budget remains.
implementedAuxiliaryScorer.unknownRatioBasis: all scored prefix characters including initial input

measurement.scope: RNN scoring only; no conversation generation or quality measurement
measurement.limitations: Single CPU process, one warmup per length, authored fictional candidate text; no concurrent-service throughput claim.

coverage: Actual loaded RNN scoring, stable weights and request-path rejection.
Optional host-selected auxiliary artifacts through GNOSIS without automatic learning.
Learning-run overlap rejection for selected RNN and MLP artifacts.
Actual MLP predictions become bounded evidence without changing the original current user message.
Wrong domain and private observations reject before conversational generation.
Explicit workflow observation references resolve before forecasting.
Autonomy accepts a facade with prompt_usage and without private model/tokenizer fields.
SOVENGI reports completed workflow effects when forecast preparation fails.
Existing action-SFT fixtures retain exact prompt projection, real file effects and oversized-context rejection.
connectionVerification.fixtureLimits: Conversational transport fixtures are explicitly declared and do not load conversational weights or prove learned language/planning. Auxiliary RNN and MLP computations use actual existing own weights.

trainedCoordinationVerification.fixture: Two actual small random-weight Transformers; own selector trained for 40 epochs on declared fictional feature preferences from disjoint TRAIN/validation family IDs.
coverage: All bodies share the selector object and verified artifact identity.
The reply text and token IDs exactly match one genuinely generated candidate from at least two Transformer members.
Requests cannot change the selector path or parameters.
Corrupted selector weights reject before conversational tensor allocation.
Learning runs cannot overwrite the selector artifact.
Single-model mode rejects a trained coordination selector.

preservedSeparation: Private dialogue and saved task history are not automatically exported as a training corpus.
An RNN likelihood signal is not a factual, grammatical or semantic judge.
Metric forecasts require valid observations from the loaded model's trained domain.
Training needs explicit data provenance and finite host-configured budgets.
Available backends and historical model artifacts are not all activated merely to increase component usage.
